acceptanceCriteria: Resolved as the finding's Fix describes, with a regression test for any code change, or closed by an owner decision that rejects the finding.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: ### B3. `impact` on TypeScript claims complete coverage while missing workspace-package importers - Severity: medium (verifiers split high/medium). Core: yes. Votes: 2/2 confirmed. Reported by: rts. - Locations: `internal/contextindex/reverseimports.go:161-166` (`webSpecifierAdmitted` accepts only `.`-relative and the alias prefix), `reverseimports.go:54` (one hop, barrels stop), `internal/contextindex/receipt.go:465-467` (gap counted only when no rule exists for the suffix). - Failure: on ts-meville, `impact packages/contracts/src/scraper-runtime-topics.ts` returned 3 authoritative results, `coverage.uncertainty []`, `omitted_results 0`, and omitted two test files in other workspaces that import via `@fetfinder/contracts`. Invariant 2 broken on UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE. Spec-compliant with GPK-V0-027 (a MAY clause), so the spec needs the same fix. - Fix: resolve workspace names (package.json name/exports/main, pnpm-workspace, tsconfig paths) and follow barrel re-exports; until then, emit a named uncertainty whenever the repository declares workspaces and a changed file is reachable from a package entry point. The same root cause makes TS `affected` exclude cross-package tests (D8). - Known ticket: none.
